description: The plot illustrates "Performance w.r.t. Temperature," representing how different methods perform across a range of temperature values. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 at intervals of 2.5. The plot contains three solid lines, each with distinct markers, set against a dashed grid. The "On-policy RL" data is represented by a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 63.7 at an x-value of 0.1, rises to 69.9 at 0.2, fluctuates slightly before reaching 71.7 at 0.5 and 0.6, drops to 67.3 at 0.7, peaks at 75.2 at 0.8, and ends at 73.5 at an x-value of 1.0. A second solid line, colored dark red with star markers (whose legend label is obscured by a grey rectangle), begins at 76.1 at x=0.1, rises to 78.8 at 0.2, dips to 76.1 at 0.3 and 0.4, increases to 77.0 at 0.5 and 0.6, and reaches its highest points of 80.6 at both 0.8 and 1.0, with a slight dip to 78.8 at 0.9. The "SFT" data is shown as a solid dark teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers; it begins at 76.1 at x=0.1, gradually declines to 74.3 at 0.3 and 0.4, drops sharply to its lowest point of 69.9 at 0.5, spikes to 76.1 at 0.6, and then fluctuates, ending at 74.3 at an x-value of 1.0.
